summary.text: Bill Bain is the Republican candidate for Michigan State Senate District 27 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the August 4 Republican primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Flushing Township trustee in his second term and a former UAW executive board officer.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Bain said he serves as a Flushing Township trustee in his second term and as a Genesee County Metro Alliance trustee.
He said he was a UAW executive board officer trustee from 1999 to 2002 and ran a lawnscaping company during a six-year layoff from General Motors.
Bain said he had been a Democrat for years before switching to the Republican Party.
He listed lowering utility costs by repealing PA 233, which he described as taking away local zoning authority over solar and wind projects, as a key campaign message.
